inputs.prompt: A man sits in a small meeting room in the late afternoon. He is the only person in the picture. From 0 to 0.8 seconds he looks at a wall screen that is outside the picture, beyond its right edge, reading it with his lips closed. At 0.9 seconds he starts to speak, his eyes still on that screen, and says in a calm, quietly impressed voice, in American English: "His update's already here." His lips close for a moment. Then he turns his head toward a point just beside the camera on its right side, never into the lens, and adds: "His Peer gave it." His acting is understated and natural, like a real person in a documentary. The camera is locked on a tripod and does not move. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no music, no subtitles and no text.
